name: TSA Prepared Presentation (Phase 2 Preview)
description: Evaluates speeches based on official Technology Student Association (TSA) Prepared Presentation guidelines.

criteria.name: Introduction
criteria.description: Engages the audience effectively, clearly states the topic, and provides a compelling preview of main points.
criteria.exemplary_anchor: Captivating hook, crystal-clear thesis statement, and seamless transition into the body of the speech.
criteria.developing_anchor: Weak or missing hook, unclear purpose, or disorganized opening that fails to capture interest.

criteria.name: Body Content & Argumentation
criteria.description: Presents well-organized, supported ideas with logical progression and strong evidence.
criteria.exemplary_anchor: Rigorous logical structure, persuasive supporting evidence, and seamless transitions between key arguments.
criteria.developing_anchor: Superficial points, lack of supporting evidence, or disorganized rambling without clear progression.

criteria.name: Conclusion
criteria.description: Summarizes main points effectively and delivers a memorable closing statement.
criteria.exemplary_anchor: Strong synthesis of core takeaways and a resonant, memorable concluding thought.
criteria.developing_anchor: Abrupt ending, missing summary of key points, or weak closing statement.

criteria.name: Voice & Delivery
criteria.description: Demonstrates excellent vocal projection, clarity, professional poise, and engaging expression.
criteria.exemplary_anchor: Professional presence with powerful voice projection, articulate pronunciation, and engaging non-verbal poise.
criteria.developing_anchor: Distracting mannerisms, poor projection, mumbled articulation, or lack of professional composure.

criteria.name: Time Management
criteria.description: Adheres strictly to the required time limit (3 to 5 minutes).
criteria.exemplary_anchor: Pefectly paced presentation finishing comfortably within the 3 to 5-minute window.
criteria.developing_anchor: Significant time violation (significantly under 3 minutes or exceeding 5 minutes).
